style: Create a single production-ready transparent-background character sprite for the urban fantasy card fighting game Squabblemon. Stylized 2D anime fighting-game key art, Marvel vs Capcom and Guilty Gear influence, rich cel shading, crisp expressive black ink linework, punchy highlights, polished hand-painted detail. One full-body ADULT character, complete head, hands, feet and props inside frame with 8% margin. Portrait 2:3 composition, roughly 1024x1536. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no opaque backdrop, no floor or shadow plane. Centered large clean silhouette, same readable quality as premium fighting-game character select art. No card frame, no UI, no typography, no logos or watermarks. Local accent energy should stay subtle and preserve empty transparency.

characters.name: Homeless YN
characters.subject: A resourceful young adult male street survivor wearing a layered oversized olive coat, patched trousers, worn high-top sneakers, knit beanie and sturdy backpack with a rolled blanket. Upright confident guard, one hand holding the backpack strap. Dignified, resilient face; no caricature of illness or misery.

characters.name: Sports Prodigy
characters.subject: A talented young adult female multi-sport street athlete in cobalt basketball shorts, compression leggings and a sleeveless gold-trim jersey, carrying a basketball under one arm, bright trainers and sport goggles pushed onto her head. Explosive starting stance, fierce determined expression.

characters.name: Fein
characters.subject: A wiry adult male urban chaos fighter with messy spiked hair, sleepless energetic eyes, purple windbreaker, mismatched layered streetwear and lime sneakers. Restless forward lean with open claw-like hands, tiny jagged purple energy accents. Human, no gore, no needles or drug paraphernalia.

characters.name: Alchy
characters.subject: An adult stocky male late-night regular with tousled hair and scruffy beard, maroon bowling shirt over white undershirt, relaxed dark trousers and worn loafers. Brown-bag-wrapped bottle held loosely down at his side, swaying defensive fighting stance with amber splash energy. Clearly adult, no brand names.

characters.name: STUD
characters.subject: A confident masculine-presenting adult Black woman street fighter, sharp low fade, subtle ear studs, white tank under a sleeveless indigo denim vest, broad dark cargo pants, heavy black boots, silver chain. Athletic build and strong protective stance, one fist at her chest, cool commanding expression. Respectful authentic masculine style.

characters.name: Goth Kid
characters.subject: A young adult goth street fighter, age 22, pale skin, black choppy hair with one deep purple streak, layered black hoodie and long distressed coat, loose trousers with silver chains, platform boots, small headphones around neck. Reserved crossed-arm stance, violet shadow wisps, sophisticated moody face.

characters.name: Stoner Jr.
characters.subject: A laid-back adult male age 25 with short curly hair, moss-green hoodie, headphones around neck, bright tie-dye shirt, wide beige cargo pants and skate shoes. Half-lidded relaxed smile, peace sign, a few soft green vapor ribbons around sneakers. No cigarette or drug equipment, no minors.

characters.name: Stoner Sr.
characters.subject: An older adult male age 55 with long gray-streaked locs, salt-and-pepper beard, bucket hat, dark green utility vest over faded tie-dye tee, loose corduroy trousers and worn trainers. Calm wise confident stance, holding a metal insulated tea cup; soft green aura. No drugs or smoking equipment.

characters.name: Divorced Dad
characters.subject: A tired but determined middle-aged adult dad with short graying hair and beard, navy zip-up fleece over wrinkled polo, faded jeans, chunky white dad sneakers, keys clipped at waist and a travel mug. Sleeves pushed up, stubborn comeback fighting stance and wry expression.

characters.name: BBL Nice
characters.subject: A glamorous curvy adult woman street fighter with warm smile, long honey-blonde ponytail, pastel-pink sporty cropped jacket over a fully opaque fitted top, coordinated high-waisted full-length pants and white platform sneakers. Confident welcoming pose, small pink heart energy accents. Fashionable nonsexual full-body game character, proportionate anatomy.

characters.name: BBL Demon
characters.subject: A glamorous curvy adult woman rival fighter with long jet-black hair and burgundy streaks, black and crimson varsity jacket over a fully opaque top, red high-waisted cargo pants, black chunky boots and silver hoop earrings. Fierce challenging stance, red-violet infernal aura arcs. Fashionable nonsexual full-body character, no nudity or sexual focus.

characters.name: Break
characters.subject: An adult Asian woman breakdance battle fighter with short black hair, cobalt tracksuit with white stripes, knee pads, wrist wraps and clean high-top trainers. Powerful low side-lean dance stance, one hand extended, one leg sweeping but entire body visible, electric-blue circular motion accents. Distinct upright transition pose.

characters.name: Krump
characters.subject: An adult muscular Black male krump dancer with short locs, orange sleeveless shirt, loose charcoal trousers, orange trainers and wrist wraps. Wide grounded stance, chest popped forward, fists raised outward, intense joyful battle expression, small orange impact slashes. Full body fully visible.

characters.name: Bboy
characters.subject: An adult Latino male b-boy dancer in teal windbreaker, red knit cap, baggy tan trousers and white-red retro sneakers. Dynamic one-handed freeze, legs bent high into a clean silhouette, all limbs fully within frame, teal spiral swoosh. Anatomy correct, distinctly different from standing Break and Krump.

characters.name: Yung Hustle
characters.subject: A young adult Black male entrepreneur street fighter in mustard-yellow puffer vest over black hoodie, fitted dark cargo pants, yellow-black sneakers and tidy braids. Crossbody bag with a few neatly folded flyers, smartphone in one hand, confident forward-moving stance and optimistic expression. No brand logos.

characters.name: Failed Rapper
characters.subject: An adult male underground rapper with narrow goatee, oversized purple bomber, faded graphic-free shirt, baggy jeans and scuffed high-top sneakers. Cheap wired microphone in one hand and a small stack of mixtape CD cases in the other. Determined stubborn performance fighting pose, comic purple sound accents; sympathetic satire.

characters.name: Failed Athlete
characters.subject: An adult former athlete in his 30s with short curly hair, faded green varsity jacket over gray tee, old team shorts over compression leggings, visible knee brace and worn basketball sneakers. Holds a small dented trophy at his side, defiant comeback stance, determination rather than humiliation.

characters.name: Incel
characters.subject: A fictional adult male socially awkward internet archetype, pale skin, untidy brown hair and faint stubble, oversized slate hoodie, loose charcoal trousers, beat-up sneakers. Clutching a laptop covered only in generic geometric stickers, hunched defensive stance with tiny gray notification shards. Satirical urban fighting-game villain, no hate symbols, no text.

characters.name: Red Pill
characters.subject: A fictional adult male abrasive podcast-debate archetype with slicked-back hair, trimmed beard, red leather jacket over black tee, slim charcoal trousers and red-black trainers. Holds a small podcast microphone while pointing emphatically, confrontational fighting stance with red angular speech-bubble energy. No actual pills, no hate symbols, no real-person likeness.
